title: An Orangist correspondent at Basle to William V, 17 Aug 1796 (KHA Prins Willem V inv. 339; DECODE R2234)

steps.what: Fetched R2234 scan and key records R2235 (two sheets) and R2240 with the session cookie.
Transcribed the R2235 Schrijf Tafel: five alphabets D,G,L,N,R; D/R and G/N inverse pairs, L self-inverse.
Transcribed the letter (1321 cipher letters) from rotated crops.
Whole section D under alphabet D: line 1 reads ('depuis le 12 juillet'), line 2 does not.
All five alphabets on lines 2-5: G, L, N, R read in turn; one alphabet per line, cycling from the section capital.
Whole letter decrypted and corrected for transcription slips into reading.txt.

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 1207 tokens, 113 types, fr-modern order 4: reading -2.599 per letter; random keys -7.231 (z 12.1); key annealed onto shuffled ciphertext best -3.604 (mean -3.675, z 28.7); annealer on the real text -3.113. Verdict: pass.

validation.notes: claimed per-occurrence score -2.08; polyphony 0.082; 107 unread tokens left out; annealer on the real text from random keys reached -3.113

outcome.method_basis: The key sheet R2235 (five alphabets) is filed in the same KHA inventory number and the DECODE record note points to it; the project found the one-alphabet-per-line cycling rule and decrypted the whole letter.
outcome.notes: Every cipher letter has a value; a few words stay unresolved because of transcription slips, signature not read.
